```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, comment = "", message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

## Extract and transform (4.1 and 4.2)
The notebook shows the code and the saved log of the last run, so knitting does not request the site again.
Knit with `params = list(rerun = TRUE)` to scrape again.

```{r code, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat("```r\n", paste(readLines("q4_scrape_clean.R"), collapse = "\n"), "\n```\n", sep = "")
```

```{r run, eval = params$rerun}
source("q4_scrape_clean.R", echo = TRUE, max.deparse.length = Inf)
```
```{r log, eval = !params$rerun}
cat(readLines("outputs/q4_console.txt"), sep = "\n")
```

## Load and analyse in PostgreSQL (4.3)
The chunk runs when the `PG*` environment variables are set. Otherwise the saved results are shown.

```{r, eval = nzchar(Sys.getenv("PGPASSWORD"))}
source("q4_load_sql.R", echo = TRUE, max.deparse.length = Inf)
```
```{r, eval = !nzchar(Sys.getenv("PGPASSWORD"))}
read.csv("outputs/q4_sql_investigation_1.csv")
read.csv("outputs/q4_sql_investigation_2.csv")
```

## SQL used
```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
for (f in list.files("sql", full.names = TRUE))
  cat("**", basename(f), "**\n\n```sql\n", paste(readLines(f), collapse = "\n"), "\n```\n\n", sep = "")
```
